question: compute/aircloud-dev: docs.aircloud.dev/pricing publishes on-demand from-rates (H100 SXM USD 2.49, A100 80GB USD 1.39, H200 SXM USD 3.09, B200 USD 4.90, B300 USD 5.90, GB200 USD 6.60) and says they are published at aircloud.dev/pricing, but that page prices only 60-month reserved clusters, quotes H200, H100 and A100 per cluster, and lists on-demand as 'opening soon' behind a waitlist. Which page is current, and is any on-demand capacity purchasable now?
why: the two first-party pages disagree on whether the on-demand rates exist and whether on-demand is available; only a sign-up or a vendor statement would settle it, and a sign-up is not permitted
